citationOrder.noteOverride: Civic Hall announced the January 30, 2016 constituent-services hackathon for 1-3 p.m. The archived page preserves the evidence in an embedded social feed; no dedicated Civic Hall calendar or event-detail page has been recovered.
The New York City Council described the Civic Hall gathering as its first CouncilStat hackathon. This supports the exact phrase "first CouncilStat hackathon," not broader first-hackathon claims.

Politico New York reported that Jamie attended a Council hackathon at Civic Hall in January before the data release, then created CallNYC after the full dataset became available. The public repository remains a project artifact for the historical implementation.
Politico New York reported that Council offices used CouncilStat differently and entered information with differing frequency, so the records needed cautious interpretation.
Politico New York covered CallNYC on March 14, 2016, in an article by Miranda Neubauer.
